create_make_constraint: create constraint jacobians and supporting data for a MuJoCo model and data
build_make_efc_type: build an efc_type array outlining the type of each constraint row for a MuJoCo model
create_make_efc_address: create an efc_address array that maps contacts to constraint row addresses
calculate_kbi: calculate stiffness, damping, and impedance of a constraint from solver parameters
count_efc_types: count equality, friction, limit, and contact constraint rows from an efc_type array
